Implemented F005 by adding `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_hook.py` (bash hook template + `install`/`uninstall`/`status` API with sentinel-based hook identification, prior-hook backup-and-chain, refuse-to-clobber backup safeguard) and wiring an `architecture hook --install/--uninstall/--status [--auto-regen] [--json]` subcommand into `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture.py`. The hook itself: chains any prior `pre-commit` via `pre-commit.pre-dontpanic`, filters staged files against the four architecture globs, runs `dontpanic architecture status --json` (warn-only default) or `architecture regen --json-only` + `git add docs/architecture/architecture.json` (`--auto-regen`), and fails-open on any error so it never blocks a commit.
